**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

- **§ 7.6** is the only MFN-style provision in the agreement, and it runs *in our favour*: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
- I checked the fee provisions (§ 7), Order Form/Affiliate ordering terms (§ 4), and General (§ 30), plus targeted searches for MFN, "no less favourable", "terms offered to", "best", exclusivity and right-of-first-refusal language. Nothing obliges Customer to extend best terms to Vendor or to match third-party offers.
- This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer; Vendor-granted MFN is welcome), so per the direction rule I left the clause untouched.
